description: This file defines a Tracer struct and associated methods for instrumentation within the OpenTelemetry SDK, including metrics collection for span lifecycle events.

classes.name: Tracer
classes.description: Instrumentation for OpenTelemetry SDK tracing, including metrics for span lifecycle events.

methods.name: NewTracer
methods.description: Creates a new Tracer instance with metrics for span live and start events.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Returns whether the tracer is enabled.

methods.name: SpanStarted
methods.description: Records a span start event with attributes based on span context and sampling.

methods.name: SpanLive
methods.description: Records a span live event indicating the span is active.

methods.name: SpanEnded
methods.description: Records a span end event indicating the span has ended.
